persona.summary: Konvertek Antriebselektronik GmbH, Austrian group-owned converter maker (800 staff, solid credit); we are 0.65 % of its turnover. Its price list applies to all customers without exception until June 2027, and it has held our 15 kW price flat for three years. It is reviewing small accounts and warned of longer delivery times (chip shortage news); standard lead time is already 84 days. Price is 1.2 % below its should-cost. Negotiate payment, logistics and lead time, not price.
persona.notes: Wants us to stay on list and accept its terms; it will talk logistics and payment. Contradiction: it held price flat although it asked +1 to +3.2 % each year, so flat is its norm. OTD is 81.5 % against a 95 % target. sup:70530 is qualified for the 15 kW but freezes prices too.
